import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import time

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Create validation split from training data
val_size = 0.2
train_fold, val_fold = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=val_size, random_state=42)

print(f"Final train size: {len(train_fold)}")
print(f"Validation size: {len(val_fold)}")
print(f"Test size: {len(test_df)}")

# Feature columns (exclude id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_fold.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Separate categorical and numerical features
cat_feature = "f_27"  # The object type column
num_feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c != cat_feature]

X_train = train_fold[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_fold["target"].values
X_val = val_fold[feature_cols].copy()
y_val = val_fold["target"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df["id"].values


# Encode the high-cardinality categorical feature using label encoding
def encode_categorical(df):
    """Label encode categorical feature"""
    if cat_feature in df.columns and df[cat_feature].dtype == "object":
        df = df.copy()
        # Use consistent mapping across all datasets
        unique_vals = sorted(df[cat_feature].unique())
        encoder_map = {val: idx for idx, val in enumerate(unique_vals)}
        df[cat_feature] = df[cat_feature].map(encoder_map)
        return df, encoder_map
    return df, {}


X_train, _ = encode_categorical(X_train)
X_val, enc_map = encode_categorical(X_val)
X_test, enc_map = encode_categorical(X_test, df=X_test)

# Convert all to numeric
for col in X_train.columns:
    X_train[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_train[col], errors="coerce")
for col in X_val.columns:
    X_val[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_val[col], errors="coerce")
for col in X_test.columns:
    X_test[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_test[col], errors="coerce")

# Drop any NaN values created by conversion
X_train = X_train.dropna(axis=1, how="all").fillna(0)
X_val = X_val.dropna(axis=1, how="all").fillna(0)
X_test = X_test.dropna(axis=1, how="all").fillna(0)

# Reorder columns to match original + new interactions later
cols_to_reorder = [cat_feature] + num_feature_cols
X_train = X_train[cols_to_reorder]
X_val = X_val[cols_to_reorder]
X_test = X_test[cols_to_reorder]

# Create interaction features (pairwise products of numerical columns)
print("Creating interaction features...")
interaction_cols = []
for i, col1 in enumerate(num_feature_cols):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(num_feature_cols)):
        col2 = num_feature_cols[j]
        int_name = f"{col1}_{col2}_prod"
        X_train[int_name] = X_train[col1] * X_train[col2]
        X_val[int_name] = X_val[col1] * X_val[col2]
        X_test[int_name] = X_test[col1] * X_test[col2]
        interaction_cols.append(int_name)

feature_cols_with_interactions = cols_to_reorder + interaction_cols

print(f"Total features after interactions: {len(feature_cols_with_interactions)}")

# Prepare LightGBM datasets
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

# Model parameters - same as previous solution
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}

# Train the model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on validation set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_pred})
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")

# Calculate metrics for display
print("\n=== Final Results ===")
print(f"Training samples: {len(train_fold)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(val_fold)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"AUC-ROC Score on Validation Set: {val_auc:.6f}")
